implemented_locally: Canonical usage events are attributable to tenant, organisation, project, environment, optional Agent version, Mission and Action.
Usage event identity is idempotent and conflicting event reuse is rejected.
Estimated cost is separated from settled and unsettled non-estimated cost.
Settlement identity is deterministic and a usage event cannot be settled twice under different settlement identities.
Settlement provider, currency and amount must reconcile exactly to the recorded usage event.
Local ledger state is protected by atomic writes and a private operation lock.
Summaries group by usage kind, unit and currency; mixed dimensions do not produce a combined scalar total.
